# Introduction

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(ggplot2)

systemfonts::register_variant(
  name = "Libertinus Normal",
  family = "Libertinus Sans",
  weight = "normal"
)

sd_cols <- c(
    `green`   = "#00a5a6",
    `pink`    = "#e03d90",
    `orange`  = "#fc6538",
    `purple`  = "#6a3ecb",
    `blue`    = "#0058dc",
    `brown`   = "#a75237"
  )

theme_set(theme_bw())
update_theme(
  plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), "cm"),
  text = element_text(family = "Libertinus Normal"),
)
```
